name: Carved Ogee Masjid
summary: A substantial ogee prayer vault rises between one grounded minaret and a short side buttress, opening around a generous carved entrance.
why: The sculpted vault and its ogee counterform share x58. A shorter minaret on x37 connects to the hall through one common y76 foundation, while a low right buttress balances the mass. The minaret collar belongs to its shaft, and the large entrance is a true cutout through the whole facade.
risk: The large carved entrance makes this feel architectural and contemplative. The small minaret collar simplifies at launcher size.

palette.name: CARVED OGEE MASJID / JADE + IVORY + COPPER

reasonToChoose: You want a simple mosque whose character comes from its architecture and open space.
